The '''2021 [[Eliteserien]]''' was the 77th completed season of top-tier [[Association football|football]] in Norway. This was fifth season of Eliteserien as rebranding from Tippeligaen.

The season was originally scheduled to begin on 5 April and end on 27 November 2021, not including play-off matches.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fotball.no/tema/nff-nyheter/2020/hovedterminliste-menn-og-kvinner-2021/ |title=Eliteserien 2021 |website=Norges Fotballforbund |language=no |publisher=Eliteserien |date=17 November 2020}}</ref> Restrictions enforced by the government due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Norway|COVID-19 pandemic]] forced the [[Norwegian Football Federation]] to postpone the start several times and the league started on 9 May 2021.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.fotball.no/tema/nff-nyheter/2021/plan-for-oppstart-av-toppfotballen/|title=Plan for oppstart av toppfotballen |language=no |website=Norges Fotballforbund |date=2021-03-31|accessdate=2021-04-04}}</ref> The last round was played on 12 December 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/fotballdata/turnering/terminliste/?fiksId=174382|title=Eliteserien 2021 - Terminliste|website=Norwegian Football Federation|access-date=6 November 2021|language=no}}</ref>

[[FK Bodø/Glimt|Bodø/Glimt]] were the defending champions. [[Tromsø IL|Tromsø]] and [[Lillestrøm SK|Lillestrøm]] joined as the promoted clubs from the [[2020 Norwegian First Division]]. They replaced [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] and [[IK Start]] who were relegated to the [[2021 Norwegian First Division]].

==Teams==
Sixteen teams competed in the league – the top fourteen teams from the previous season, and two teams promoted from [[2020 Norwegian First Division|Norwegian First Division]]. The promoted teams were [[Tromsø IL|Tromsø]] and [[Lillestrøm SK|Lillestrøm]], both returning to the top flight after an absence of just one year. They replaced [[Aalesunds FK|Aalesund]] and [[IK Start]], both relegated after a season's presence.

== Relegation play-offs ==
<!--{{Main|2021 Eliteserien Promotion/relegation play-offs}}-->
The 14th-placed team in the Eliteserien, Brann, played against the winners of the [[2021 Norwegian First Division#Promotion play-offs|First Division promotion play-offs]], Jerv, on neutral ground to decide who would play in the Eliteserien next season.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.fotball.no/turneringer/eliteserien/2021/justering-av-kamptidspunkter-for-kvalifiseringsspill-til-eliteserien-2022/|title=Justering av kamptidspunkter for kvalifiseringsspill til Eliteserien 2022|website=Norwegian Football Federation|date=15 November 2021|access-date=4 December 2021|language=no}}</ref>

|time       = 19:00 [[Central European Time|CET]]
|team1      = [[SK Brann|Brann]]
|score      = 4–4
|aet        = yes
